title: Leafhold
description: A classic multiplayer network built on our own custom engine.
body:
Welcome to **Leafhold**, a premium multiplayer network engineered from the ground up by our dedicated development studio.  Powered by our own, in-house, plugins, Leafhold delivers a flawless, competitive, and highly optimized experience where gameplay always comes first.

We don't rely on bloated, performance-heavy public setups. Our studio builds custom systems specifically designed to elevate your journey:
- **Skyblock**: Expand your Island, level up custom crop and resource generators, and dominate a finely balanced player-driven market.
- **Integrated competitive minigames**: Step away from the island grind and challenge the community in custom-coded minigames designed to test your skills.
- **Dynamic server-wide events**: Participate in automated economy and combat events that challenge the entire player base in real time, offering exclusive rewards.
